problems.title: Find Center of Star Graph
problems.notes: trivial but a good 'read graph structure fast' warm-up — the center is whichever node appears in both of the first edge's endpoints twice

problems.title: Course Schedule IV
problems.notes: precompute all-pairs reachability (Floyd-Warshall or per-node DFS in topo order) — a realistic dependency-resolution query problem

problems.title: All Ancestors of a Node in a Directed Acyclic Graph
problems.notes: DFS/BFS from each node, or propagate ancestor sets forward in topo order — a realistic 'who depends on this' query

problems.title: Loud and Rich
problems.notes: DFS memoized over a DAG of 'richer than' relations — a dependency-propagation problem much like GraphRAG entity resolution

problems.title: Count Nodes With the Highest Score
problems.notes: subtree-size product scoring — PageRank-adjacent 'importance' scoring computed with a single post-order DFS

problems.title: Minimum Time to Collect All Apples in a Tree
problems.notes: DFS the tree; only count edges on a root-to-apple path, and count them twice since you must walk back

problems.title: Largest Color Value in a Directed Graph
problems.notes: topo sort + DP tracking a 26-color frequency vector per node; a cycle means no valid topo order, so return -1
